name: Small Print
summary: A set of free public tools that make the real cost of everyday financial decisions easier to understand without jargon, spin, or incentives.
details: Reframes monthly affordability into totals, cost per year, cost per mile/day, and long-term repetition effects so people can see the "small print" clearly.
Not a comparison site and not financial advice.
Built as a static, client-side app with Vite, React, and TypeScript, prioritising clarity, correctness, and restraint.
focus: Exposing misleading or asymmetric framing in systems
Building tools that empower users without manipulating outcomes
Shipping small, complete products outside traditional organisational constraints
